title: Dev — Merge conflict
description: Conflict-resolution workflow: analyze both branch intents, resolve semantic conflicts safely, and verify merged behavior.

steps.title: Read both branch diffs
steps.notes: Understand intent on each side; note semantic conflicts (not just text). Record decisions/risks in .vibe/research/<task-id>.md.

steps.title: Merge & verify
steps.notes: Keep both changes when needed; run build + related tests before marking resolved. Update .vibe/research/<task-id>.md with final merge decision and verification notes.
verify_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const active=path.join(root,'.vibe','active.json');const legacy=path.join(root,'.vibe','state.json');let st;if(fs.existsSync(active)){const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(active,'utf8'));const seg=p.session_segment;if(!seg||typeof seg!=='string'){console.error('Invalid .vibe/active.json');process.exit(1);}const sp=path.join(root,'.vibe','sessions',seg,'state.json');if(!fs.existsSync(sp)){console.error('Missing session state: '+sp);process.exit(1);}st=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sp,'utf8'));}else if(fs.existsSync(legacy)){st=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(legacy,'utf8'));}else{console.error('No Vibe state: expected .vibe/active.json + .vibe/sessions/<segment>/state.json, or legacy .vibe/state.json');process.exit(1);}const id=String(st.task_id||'').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g,'_');const f=path.join(root,'.vibe/research',id+'.md');if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('Missing research file: '+f);process.exit(1);}const b=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!/(merge decision|conflict resolution|resolved by|verification)/i.test(b)){console.error('Record merge decision + verification notes in .vibe/research/<task-id>.md before approving.');process.exit(1);}"
